  - Level 3: Before you teach or file a note, name which rung you are on - define-at-dinner without a real use means Explanation, not Application.
  - Level 4: Depth is per idea - a professor can sit at Level 1 on crypto while a teen ships at Level 5; flashcard recall can mimic depth without Application or Systems.
  - Level 5: Write Level 1 through Level 5 on each garden claim, then practice until you create or extend from the idea - [[The Feynman Technique]] only stress-tests the first two rungs.
  - A professor learning cryptocurrency may sit at Level 1; a high school programmer shipping patches may reach Level 5 - depth is not years of school.
  - Garden notes use Level 1 through Level 5 in `key_concept` for this ladder on each atomic claim.
  - Progression: Recognize, then Explain, then Use, then Connect, then Create.
